label: Unrestricted free absence with companions gives A2 at w
meaning: For a concrete object y existing at w, take a distinct concrete candidate x that could exist (companions); unrestricted free absence gives a world accessible from w where x exists and y does not, so y could fail to exist. Recombination supports A2 only in its unrestricted form: the restricted form says nothing about a candidate that exists at every accessible world, and the difference between the two is exactly the possible absence of every companioned concrete candidate (certified difference).
